description: Search the kari catalog (shoes, clothing, bags, accessories) with filters. Returns products with price, size range and a link to the website. sizes is the size range of the model, not stock: check stock with get_product or check_availability.

city_id.description: city_id from find_city; prices and stock depend on the city. Default: capital

country.description: Country: ru — Russia, kz — Kazakhstan, by — Belarus

query.description: What to look for, in the user language, e.g. "белые кроссовки"

size.description: Size as on the website, e.g. "38"

name: search_products

currency.description: ISO currency code: RUB, KZT or BYN

discount_percent.description: Discount badge in percent, as on the website

old_price.description: Crossed-out price; present only when the website shows a markdown

price.description: Selling price as on the website

sizes.description: Size range of the model, regardless of stock

title: Search products
